camel_example: aliyun sddp DescribeTables --region cn-hangzhou --ServiceRegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --PageSize 10 --ProductCode MaxCompute --InstanceId 1 --CurrentPage 1 --RuleId 333322 --Lang zh_cn --ProductId 1 --PackageId 555555 --RiskLevelId 2 --TemplateId 1 --Name test
description_en: Queries tables in data assets, such as MaxCompute and RDS, that Data Security Center is authorized to access

name: DescribeTables

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Default value: zh_cn. Valid values:

zh_cn: Chinese.

en_us: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh_cn。取值：
zh_cn：中文。
en_us：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The search keyword. Fuzzy search is supported. For example, if you enter test, all results that contain test are returned
parameters.help_zh:
搜索的关键词，支持模糊匹配。
例如，输入test，会搜索出搜索项中包含test的全部数据信息
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the product to which the data asset table belongs. Call the [DescribeDataAssets](~~DescribeDataAssets~~) operation to obtain this ID
parameters.help_zh: 数据资产表所属产品ID。该产品ID可调用[DescribeDataAssets](~~DescribeDataAssets~~)接口获取
parameters.name: product_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the product to which the data asset table belongs. Valid values include MaxCompute, OSS, ADS, OTS, and RDS. For more information about the supported products, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/212906.html
parameters.help_zh: 数据资产表所属产品名称，包括MaxCompute、OSS、RDS等。关于支持的产品名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/212906.html
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the risk level for the data asset table. Each risk level ID corresponds to a risk level name. Valid values:

1: N/A. No sensitive data is detected.

2: S1. Level 1 sensitive data.

3: S2. Level 2 sensitive data.

4: S3. Level 3 sensitive data.

5: S4. Level 4 sensitive data
parameters.help_zh:
数据资产表的风险等级ID。
每个风险等级ID都有对应的风险等级名称。取值：
1：N/A：未识别到敏感数据。
2：S1：1级敏感数据。
3：S2：2级敏感数据。
4：S3：3级敏感数据。
5：S4：4级敏感数据
parameters.name: risk_level_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the sensitive data detection rule that the data asset table hits. Call the [DescribeRules](~~DescribeRules~~) operation to obtain this ID
parameters.help_zh: 数据资产表命中的敏感数据识别规则ID。该敏感数据识别规则ID可调用[DescribeRules](~~DescribeRules~~)接口获取
parameters.name: rule_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance to which the data asset table belongs. Call the [DescribeInstances](~~DescribeInstances~~) operation to obtain this ID

parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the package to which the data asset table belongs. Call the [DescribePackages](~~DescribePackages~~) operation to obtain this ID
